summary: Wrote pnr/floorplan.json (core_utilization_pct=45 with reasons for utilization, pins, power grid and clock/reset) and pnr/pin_order.cfg (45 pins: North baud_div[15:0], parity_mode[1:0]; South clk, rst_n; East tx, tx_ready, rx_data[7:0], rx_valid, frame_err, parity_err, overrun_err; West rx, tx_data[7:0], tx_valid). No tool was run by me; floorplan/PDN/pin-order checks are pending in the runtime.
assumptions: Bus bits are named like tx_data[0] in the netlist, so the prefix 'tx_data.*' covers all bits.
Default SKY130 PDN (no strap overrides) because pnr_ranges.yaml defines no strap ranges.
OpenLane matches each pin_order pattern against the whole pin name (an exact name like 'tx' does not match 'tx_data[0]' or 'tx_ready'); if it used prefix matching the parser would report overlaps.
Order of pins within a side is not functionally significant for this small block.
Synthesized area 8363.02 um^2 is the standard-cell area before tap/fill/CTS/resizer buffers; 45% leaves headroom for those.
Top-level port list equals spec.yaml interfaces (arch.yaml uart_top ports_from_spec: true): 45 pins total; overrun_err remains a real output port even though driven constant 0.
open_issues: If CTS shows leaf-fanout problems later, utilization (30-65%) is the sanctioned flop-spread knob per lesson s2s-cts-003, to be screened with recorded experiments.
PDN connectivity and 'no unpowered rows' are not yet confirmed; they need the runtime's real floorplan/PDN run.
Pre-layout hold slack at nom_ff_n40C_1v95 is -0.003 ns (ideal clock); expected to be fixed by post-CTS hold repair, but should be tracked by the timing owner, not the floorplan.

self_assessment.reason: Choices are standard and within the allowed ranges, but no real floorplan, PDN or pin-order parser run has confirmed them yet; pin-pattern matching semantics are assumed full-match.
